prompt:
Generate a publication-quality COMPUTER SCIENCE RESEARCH FIGURE, not a business infographic. Fresh standalone request. Landscape 3:2, high resolution PNG. Strict flat vector-like scientific typography and geometry. White canvas, 80% white space/background; only pale steel blue #E8EFF3 and pale sage #EBF0EA group fills. ONE muted burnt-orange #B97049 accent to highlight the single central contribution. Thin precise 1-point neutral lines. All text pure black. Chinese typography like clean printed Heiti, compact, consistent; main labels only modestly larger. NO cartoons, NO illustrations, NO icons, NO pictograms, NO clipart, NO people, NO books, NO paper sheets, NO folded corners, NO computers, NO gears, NO magnifying glass, NO phones, NO cylinders, NO logos, NO gradients, NO shadows, NO 3D, NO big colored title bars, NO glossy shapes. Represent all concepts with typography, arrays, aligned ruled regions, fine connectors, brackets and small circles. Preserve the semantic relationships below but reinterpret every illustrative object as a compact plain typographic group. Use grouping and alignment, not repeated boxed cards. One visual focal point; secondary mechanisms low visual weight. No decorative title. Prevent text collisions. Do not invent labels or relationships.
精确标签及构图：三个区域。左“仓颉协调器”，三行“领取任务”“保存事件”“校验提交”。中间“任务上下文”，三组“题目版本”“学生作答”“历史动作”；学生作答下面只能有“原始作答”“实际步骤”。右“Python工具循环”，四步规划→调用工具→接收反馈→生成结果环形细线；旁边“检索”“SymPy”“Qwen / ApiPoolProvider”，标题“受控工具”；底部“有界迭代”。仓颉将上下文传给Python，Python生成结果回到仓颉校验提交，返回线沿底部外缘走，不穿学生作答区。底部另一个“学生新作答”只连上下文中的学生作答。工具输出属于Python反馈，与学生原始作答明确分离。所有文字黑色，不增加任何条目；重点用浅橙突出“学生作答”，其他浅蓝灰。不要文件纸张图标或堆叠效果。

三个并排面板，精确标签。(a)任务对照：新的作答→资格校验→正向证据。资格校验内四行“正确”“无辅助”“首次有效”“来源有效”。(b)独立练习：顶部“已确认作答”，分左右两条独立平行通道。左通道“正确”→“正向证据”；右通道“错误”→“负向证据”。两通道中间共同经过一条水平浅橙区域，标注“通过更新资格”；两条垂直箭头穿过该区域但保持分离，绝对不能汇合，明确正确对应正向，错误对应负向。(c)复习记录：复习回答→反馈与下次安排→复习计划。底部公共“学习证据”只接受a的正向证据和b的正向/负向证据，c复习计划为终点，不与其他节点相连。只写这些标签，没有掌握度。黑色文字，浅灰蓝分组，以资格区作为唯一橙色重点。
